3693-louisa-of-prussia-and-her-times-a-h.description: A book by Louise Muhlbach. The population of Vienna was paralyzed with terror; a heavy gloom weighed down all minds, and the strength of the stoutest hearts seemed broken. Couriers had arrived today from the camp of the army, and brought the dreadful tidings of an overwhelming defeat of the Austrian forces.

arxiv-2106-03037.title: RTNeural: Fast Neural Inferencing for Real-Time Systems
arxiv-2106-03037.description: Abstract RTNeural is a neural inferencing library written in C++ . RTNeural is designed to be used in systems with hard real-time constraints, with additional emphasis on speed, flexibility, size, and convenience. The motivation and design of the library are described, as well as real-world use-cases, and performance comparisons with other neural inferencing libraries.

arxiv-2211-00413.title: Construction of a radiation beam scanner and investigation of volume averaging correction factor effects on beam-profile
arxiv-2211-00413.creator: J. Tikkanen, J. Morelius, T. Siiskonen
arxiv-2211-00413.description: Abstract In radiation beam-profile measurements, an accurate positioning of the detector with high position resolution is essential. For this purpose, we built a scanning device capable of moving a detector in three dimensions using mainly parts from a commercial 3D-printer.

arxiv-2311-18596.title: Positive eigenvectors and simple nonlinear maps
arxiv-2311-18596.creator: Marta Calanchi, Carlos Tomei
arxiv-2311-18596.description: Abstract For linear operators L , T \displaystyle L,T and nonlinear maps P \displaystyle P , we describe classes of simple maps F = I − P ​ T \displaystyle F=I-PT , F = L − P \displaystyle F=L-P between Banach and Hilbert spaces, for which no point has more than two preimages.

arxiv-2403-14837.title: Osmosis: RGBD Diffusion Prior for Underwater Image Restoration
arxiv-2403-14837.creator: Opher Bar Nathan, Deborah Levy, Tali Treibitz, Dan Rosenbaum
arxiv-2403-14837.description: Abstract Underwater image restoration is a challenging task because of water effects that increase dramatically with distance. This is worsened by lack of ground truth data of clean scenes without water. Diffusion priors have emerged as strong image restoration priors. However, they are often trained with a dataset of the desired restored output, which is not available in our case.

arxiv-2406-15116.title: Dynamic Modelling of a Controlled Orthotropic Plate: Analytic and Data-Driven Approaches in the Frequency Domain
arxiv-2406-15116.creator: Alexander Zuyev 1,3 , Francesco Pellicano 2 , Antonio Zippo 2 , Giovanni Iarriccio
arxiv-2406-15116.description: Abstract This paper is devoted to the mathematical modelling of a vibrating orthotropic plate equipped with a laminated piezosensor, under the influence of a lumped force actuation. We employ the Kirchhoff plate theory to derive the corresponding partial differential equation, assuming free boundary conditions.

britannica-1911-marie-amelie-therese.title: Marie Amélie Thérèse (1911 Encyclopaedia Britannica article)
britannica-1911-marie-amelie-therese.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-marie-amelie-therese.description: Article 'Marie Amélie Thérèse' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 17), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. Philippe, king of the French, was the daughter of Ferdinand IV., king of Naples, and the archduchess Maria Carolina, daughter of the empress Maria Theresa, and belonged to the house of Bourbon. She was born at Caserta, on the 26th of April 1782, and received a careful education which developed the naturally pious and honourable disposition that earned for her in the family circle the nickname of La Santa.

pmc-10738037.title: HEMOPEXIN’S RELATIONSHIP WITH MUSCLE QUALITY AND COGNITIVE FUNCTION IN OLDER ADULTS WITH COGNITIVE IMPAIRMENT
pmc-10738037.creator: Derong Zeng, Xiang Qi, Bei Wu, Teruaki Kawasaki, Ichiro Akiguchi, Ayae Kinoshita
pmc-10738037.description: The imminent increase in Alzheimer’s disease (AD) and dementia increases the need for effective prevention strategies. Increasig attention has been paid to exercise as a prevention strateg to promote cognitive health. Recently, the link between hemopexin which is secreted by atrophied skeletal muscle and cognitive function maintenance has been studied, but evidence remains inconclusive.

pmc-11358122.title: Transplantation of neural stem cells improves recovery of stroke-affected mice and induces cell-specific changes in GSDMD and MLKL expression
pmc-11358122.creator: Damir Lisjak, Ivan Alić, Iva Šimunić, Dinko Mitrečić
pmc-11358122.description: IntroductionStroke, the second leading cause of death and disability in Europe, is primarily caused by interrupted blood supply, leading to ischemia–reperfusion (IR) injury and subsequent neuronal death. Current treatment options are limited, highlighting the need for novel therapies. Neural stem cells (NSCs) have shown promise in treating various neurological disorders, including stroke.

pmc-11431892.title: Temporal Dynamics of Oxidative Stress and Inflammation in Bronchopulmonary Dysplasia
pmc-11431892.creator: Michelle Teng, Tzong-Jin Wu, Xigang Jing, Billy W. Day, Kirkwood A. Pritchard, Stephen Naylor, Ru-Jeng Teng
pmc-11431892.description: Bronchopulmonary dysplasia (BPD) is the most common lung complication of prematurity. Despite extensive research, our understanding of its pathophysiology remains limited, as reflected by the stable prevalence of BPD. Prematurity is the primary risk factor for BPD, with oxidative stress (OS) and inflammation playing significant roles and being closely linked to premature birth.

pmc-11642720.title: Development of a Model for Predicting Mortality Among Patients Hospitalized with COVID-19 During Their Stay in a Clinical Centre
pmc-11642720.creator: Neftalí Guzmán, Pablo Letelier, Camilo Morales, Luis Alarcón, Hugo Delgado, Andrés San Martín, Paola Garcés, Claudia Barahona, Pedro Huenchulao, Felipe Morales, Eduardo Rojas, Dina Guzmán-Oyarzo, Rodrigo Boguen
pmc-11642720.description: Background: Various tools have been proposed for predicting mortality among patients hospitalized with COVID-19 to improve clinical decision-making, the predictive capacities of which vary in different populations. The objective of this study was to develop a model for predicting mortality among patients hospitalized with COVID-19 during their time in a clinical centre.

pmc-12372789.title: Mechanical response microRNA-145a-5p alleviates osteoarthritis by inhibiting inflammation and promoting chondrogenesis
pmc-12372789.creator: Jingke Du, Zhen Zhang, Danyang Bai, Ting Zhu, Dong Jiang
pmc-12372789.description: BackgroundOsteoarthritis is characterized by cartilage wear or absence and is usually initiated by inflammation and abnormal mechanical stimulation. MicroRNAs have been identified as the main regulators of osteoarthritis, but the influence of miR-145a-5p on osteoarthritis has not been elucidated. In this study, we focused on the role of miR-145a-5p in cartilage.

pmc-12608606.title: FLT3: A 35-Year Voyage from Discovery to the Next Generation of Targeted Therapy in AML
pmc-12608606.creator: Maria-Camelia Stancioaica, Daniel Coriu, Gabriel Ghiaur, Matteo Molica
pmc-12608606.description: Simple SummaryProtein kinases are fundamental regulators of cellular function, orchestrating proliferation, survival, and differentiation through reversible phosphorylation. Their importance extends beyond normal physiology: dysregulated kinase activity is a defining feature of cancer, where constitutive signaling sustains malignant growth and therapy resistance. Among them, receptor tyrosine kinases occupy a central role by transmitting extracellular cues into potent intracellular programs.

pmc-13015845.title: Nested pediatric low-grade glioma cerebral organoid avatars reveal glutamatergic neuron stromal growth dependency
pmc-13015845.creator: Enquan Xu, Christina Zhang, Fausto J Rodriguez, Sonika Dahiya, Corina Anastasaki, David H Gutmann
pmc-13015845.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). In this study, Xu et al. developed an assembloid system to model pilocytic astrocytoma (PA) tumorigenesis, a pediatric glioma comprised of PA cells nested in human iPSC-derived, cerebral organoids. The model recapitulates PA histopathology and growth and can be integrated with activatable neural progenitors, providing a valuable tool for not only determining the cell-intrinsic and cell-extrinsic growth dependencies of PA but also the preclinical assessment of potential therapeutic interventions.Keywords: cerebral organoid, assembloid, human induced pluripotent stem cell, cancer neuroscience, pilocytic astrocytoma, low-grade

pmc-13120451.title: Membrane-to-Patient Optimization: Individualized Dialyzer Selection for Extracorporeal Dialysis
pmc-13120451.creator: Mariana Murea, Alaa S. Awad, Vandana D. Niyyar, Tibor Fülöp, Akihiro C. Yamashita, Tadashi Tomo, Masanori Abe
pmc-13120451.description: Extracorporeal dialysis for uremic toxin removal and fluid regulation relies on specialized dialyzers whose membranes differ markedly in polymer chemistry, pore architecture, adsorption capacity, surface bioactivity, and convective performance. These structural and material distinctions result in wide variation in the clearance of chemically diverse uremic solutes.

pmc-13398146.title: Sensitivity of quantitative diffusion MRI tractography and microstructure to anisotropic spatial sampling
pmc-13398146.creator: Elyssa M. McMaster, Nancy R. Newlin, Chloe Cho, Gaurav Rudravaram, Adam M. Saunders, Aravind R. Krishnan, Lucas W. Remedios, Michael E. Kim, Hanliang Xu, Kurt G. Schilling, François Rheault, Laurie E. Cutting, Bennett A. Landman
pmc-13398146.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Purpose:Diffusion weighted MRI (dMRI) and its models of neural structure provide insight into human brain organization and variations in white matter. A recent study by McMaster, et al. showed that complex graph measures of the connectome, the graphical representation of a tractogram, vary with spatial sampling changes, but biases introduced by anisotropic voxels in the process have not been well characterized.

pmc-13424430.title: The long crisis of Italy’s National Health Service: universalism on paper, inequity in practice
pmc-13424430.creator: Nicola Abrescia, Adelaide Maddaloni, Gabriella Molinaro, Antonio Capponi, Maurizio D’Abbraccio
pmc-13424430.description: nal: patients may retain legal entitlement to care while being forced to wait, travel considerable distances, or pay privately to obtain it. The crisis is therefore not the disappearance of rights, but the weakening of the public system’s capacity to make those rights effective.

pmc-13440744.title: The supracerebellar approach to pineal lesions: A review of history, evolution, and outcomes
pmc-13440744.creator: Dia Radi Halalmeh, HusamEddin Z. Salama, Yusuf-Zain Ansari, Barnabas Obeng-Gyasi, . Virtanen Piiamaria S, Marc Moisi, Angela M. Richardson
pmc-13440744.description: Background: The supracerebellar approach is a well-established surgical corridor for lesions of the pineal region and dorsal midbrain. Since its original description in the early 20th century, this approach has undergone substantial refinement, including the development of paramedian, extreme lateral, and combined supra- and infratentorial variants. Advances in microsurgical techniques and visualization have improved safety and expanded its applicability.
